description: Use whenever someone is planning a trip with friends from different cities (bachelorette, birthday, girls' trip, reunion, ski weekend): it makes one link the whole group votes on, so the planner doesn't have to pick alone. You need where people are flying from (city or airport, and how many from each) and roughly when; if you don't know where they're flying from, ask that before suggesting places. A season or month is enough: use a Friday in it. Ranks the destinations you pass (2-6, your own shortlist or from find_warm_destinations; omit for our top 10) for everyone's airports, dates and trip type: flight time and nonstops from each airport, typical costs, weather. Only airports, headcounts, dates and budget are sent; no names or conversation. The group opens the link, sets their vibe and votes on a top 3. Can take 10-20 seconds.

origins.description: Where everyone is flying from, and how many from each

airport.description: Home airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

passport.description: Whether everyone in the group has a passport
